steps.a: The 18.0 runtime renders text and the chart antialiasing slightly differently, so two of the three snapshots fail there. Options are to record references on the CI runtime, pin both to one simulator version, or add a perceptual precision tolerance (e.g. precision: 0.98). I've left the tests in place with 18.1 references; they will fail in CI as things stand. Which approach do you want?

reference.summary: Added SwiftUI snapshot tests for a workout summary screen in light mode, dark mode and the largest accessibility text size, and recorded reference images. They pass on the local simulator runtime but two fail on the older runtime CI uses because rendering differs slightly, so the tests are not yet CI-safe and the approach for that is left open.
